scripts.test: pnpm run test:api && pnpm run test:flo && pnpm run test:mobile
scripts.build: pnpm run check:mobile-config && pnpm run test && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
